question: Which Bill passed in the Lok Sabha in 2022 is for unification of three Municipal Corporations in one of the States/Union Territories of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi Municipal Corporation (Amendment) Bill.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Delhi Municipal Corporation (Amendment) Bill **aims to merge the** three existing municipal corporations** in Delhi into a single** unified entity,** namely the "Municipal Corporation of Delhi".
 
• The three existing corporations are **North Delhi **Municipal Corporation,** South Delhi** Municipal Corporation, and **East Delhi **Municipal Corporation.
 
• The proposed merger is expected to improve the **efficiency and effectiveness** of municipal services in the** national capital.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The nation of **India's capital, Delhi**, is located in the north of the continent. 
 
• Since **February 14, 2015,** Delhi's current chief minister is** Arvind Kejriwal **of the **Aam Aadmi Party**.
 
• On **May 26, 2022, Shri Vinai Kumar Saxena** became the **22nd Lieutenant Governor **of Delhi.
